faq_heading: Homes near Pacific Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Pacific Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Pacific Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Pacific Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Pacific Academy. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Pacific Academy sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 86 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,557,500, townhomes $825,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Pacific Academy?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Pacific Academy the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 96.6% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 86 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Pacific Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Bothwell Elementary School (0.6 km east), Fraser Wood Elementary (1.1 km north-west) and Fraser Heights Secondary (1.8 km north-west).

Pacific Academy is an independent school in Surrey, at 10238 168 St. It teaches kindergarten to grade 12.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Pacific Academy in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the Pacific Academy search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Pacific Academy, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Pacific Academy sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 86 homes sold within 2 km of Pacific Academy: 56 houses, 26 townhomes and 3 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,557,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Pacific Academy

11 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Pacific Academy in a straight line (7 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Bothwell Elementary School, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Surrey Christian School, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Fraser Heights Secondary (1.8 km); the nearest independent school is Gobind Sarvar School (2.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Fraser Wood Elementary (1.1 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-12) is Gobind Sarvar School, 2.8 km south of Pacific Academy.
